message: Node.js 18 in GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job test) is past its end of life (Node.js 18 ended on 2025-04-30) and gets no more releases, security fixes included
fix: Move to a supported Node.js LTS line in GitHub Actions: 22 (until 2027-04-30), 24 (until 2028-04-30) or 26 (until 2029-04-30)
